url.label: Job link
url.hint: A public page, such as Greenhouse or the company's website. Add LinkedIn jobs with the browser button or by <paste>pasting the text</paste>.
url.unavailable: That page could not be opened: it may not be responding, may ask you to sign in or may load the job with JavaScript. Copy the job text and paste it here.

text.title: Role
text.hint: Paste the whole posting: requirements, conditions and salary if it says.

title: New job
intro: Paste a job's link or text. If you already had it, it is not added twice; then your agent reads it and pulls out its details.

linkedin.title: LinkedIn jobs are added in one of these two ways:

button.title: With the browser button
button.body: Open the job on LinkedIn and click “Send to CandidatAI” in your browser's toolbar.

paste.title: By pasting the text
paste.body: Copy the job's text and paste it. The link is already filled in.
